design_direction.rationale: People choosing a dentist check the rating and reviews before anything else, and this practice only has 3 photographs strong enough to build a page around, so leading with the 4.5-star, 114-review facts and letting patient quotes and staff/services carry the rest is more convincing than a photo-led design would be.
design_direction.signature_why: A dental practice earns trust through what patients say about the staff, so setting one review at full size does more than another photo of a hallway ever could.

published.about: We value integrity, teamwork, clinical excellence, and we work hard on a daily basis to deliver that to our beloved patients. We are a group of dental providers who truly care about our patients’ experiences. This means quality care is given and our standards never fall. To put it simply – we simply care about what we do.

blocks.heading: WELCOME TO PLANO DENTAL LOFT
blocks.text: As a Plano Dental Loft Doctor, Dr. Le can create custom, long-lasting dental implant solutions that let you eat, smile, and feel confident about your teeth once and for all. Each and every day it is our mission to not only bring back our patients’ smile but also to fully restore their dental function. BOOK YOUR APPOINTMENT

blocks.heading: Dental Crown
blocks.text: At Plano Dental Loft, we offer the services of customized dental crowns to repair damaged, cracked, or decayed teeth. Contact us today to schedule an appointment for dental crowns. Accutane over the counter

blocks.text: Restore your oral functionality with our contemporary cosmetic dentistry. Replace your missing teeth with comfortable and easy-to-wear dentures made with the highest quality. https://ufmfamilymedicine.com/clomid-over-the-counter/

blocks.heading: Teeth Cleaning
blocks.text: Tend to your oral health with professional teeth cleaning at Plano Dental Loft. Professional dental cleaning by a certified hygienist can protect your teeth from cavities & gum disease. Properly clean where your brush can’t reach. Contact us today to schedule your appointment.

blocks.heading: Implants
blocks.text: Are you looking for a permanent solution to missing teeth? Then dental implants are for you. At Plano Dental Loft, we offer state-of-the-art and customized dental implants that are securely attached in place. Enjoy the stability and strength of our restorative implant treatment. Book your appointment today. Book Your Appointment Now

blocks.text: Are you looking for a dental facility to treat your whole family? Schedule your appointment today for lifetime of health an wellness. Your trusted dental professionals offer customized solutions for your family. Our long-term oral health plan caters to all your needs, from cleaning to fillings. Teeth Cleaning Hygiene Checkup Fillings and Sealants Oral Screening Periodontal Treatment Aligners & Braces

blocks.heading: Oral Cancer Screening
blocks.text: Preventive oral care can prevent you from developing complex dental problems. A regular visit to our facility for oral cancer screening can help you keep track of your oral health and prevent diseases from spreading. Detect precancerous or early signs of cancer. Schedule your appointment today with our esteemed dentists.

blocks.heading: Fillings & Sealants
blocks.text: Keep cavities and decay at bay with our fillings and sealants. Dental sealants and fillings act as a protective barrier over your teeth, helping you keep a bright and healthy smile. To prevent your teeth from plaque and decay, book your appointment today for our Dental Sealant services.

blocks.heading: Periodontal treatment
blocks.text: Our highly trained dentists specialize in preventing, diagnosing, and treating periodontal disease. Affordable and pain-free treatment is available at Prime Dental in our relaxing offices. If you are already suffering from periodontal gum disease, schedule your appointment with our professionals. Get the treatment you need today!

testimonials.author: Nicole Grimes
testimonials.text:
The entire Staff From the doctor to the dental assistants to the front desk was extremely helpful and knowledgeable.  They made us feel welcomed.  The doctor took care of my daughter I was so grateful since her first dental exam ever ended up in a root canal.

Everyone did a wonderful job and they even allowed me to start a payment plan on the procedure.  So grateful to them all. I even scheduled my husband to be seen next.

Thank you all.

testimonials.author: Lori Boling
testimonials.text: I simply cannot say enough about Dr. George and his staff ~ they are AWESOME! I was pretty nervous when I went in for the first time, but Dr. George and his staff were very friendly and quick to make me feel comfortable and at ease. Dr. George was very thorough, explained everything and regularly made sure that I was comfortable while he worked on my teeth. My husband and I are SO HAPPY we found Dr. George. As an added bonus, they play great music in his office AND they are open some evenings and for a few hours on Saturdays. :)

testimonials.author: C
testimonials.text:
I went to Plano Dental Loft, based on a recommendation from a family member. Dr. George spend the time to hear my dental issues, did a complete exam and provided me with all the different options and pricing. He was upfront, honest and never rushed me to make a decision.
I found Dr. George to be amiable, attentive to my needs and willing to work with me through my personal situation. The staff was also pleasant and helpful. I am very impressed with the work that he did for me (cavity fillings, cleaning, broken tooth filling) and would definitely visit him again.

testimonials.author: Rama S
testimonials.text:
Excellent services!!
Dr. George and his staff are very friendly and caring. Everyone always goes the extra mile to make you feel comfortable and it feels good to know that you are  going to a team who really cares.
I was at the office last week to have a root canal done and Dr. George explained the process to me and made sure that the whole process was painless.  He personally called to check up on me the following day.
I trust that any work done by Dr. George  and his staff will be top notch. I recommend their office to anyone who wants the best.
Thank you, your team is the best !!
